uncited: - A disk file containing voxelsets stored in Morton order.
**Noise Cleaning:** Identify colors present in the background images.
**Data Encoding (Pass 2):** Iterate through the voxels in Morton order (sorted by $M(r,g,b)$).
**Data Retrieval:** To render, calculate the Morton index for selected colors.
- **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing the histogram and look-up table in memory.
It addresses the challenge of rendering large volumetric datasets that do not fit in main memory by organizing data on disk to minimize I/O latency.

It also notes that if n datasets are located next to each other, 'we can read by performing just one disk-read operation.' This implies that the seek cost is amortized or effectively O(1) per voxelset (or group of voxelsets) because the physical layout matches the logical access order, eliminating random seeks. Therefore, the claim that retrieval is O(K log K) for sorting followed by O(1) seek per voxelset is supported by the described mechanism of sorting indices to exploit spatial locality and consecutive access.
